summary: Phase 3 backend-only regression PASSED. 12/12 pytest cases green covering: /api/health init=complete, web-cookie login (no token in body, httpOnly cookie set), native-mobile login (session_token in body — confirms ADMIN_PASSWORD_ENFORCE_SYNC=true restart did NOT break auth), public /api/iap/products returns all 4 expected product IDs, /api/iap/apple/verify with bogus payload returns structured 400 'Apple API authentication failed' (NOT 422), /api/iap/google/verify with bogus payload returns structured 400 'invalid_grant: Invalid grant: account not found' (NOT 422 — proves google-auth is reached), /api/iap/status returns full plan/status JSON, Phase 2B sso-config-native public with google_ios_client_id non-null, google/native + apple/native garbage-token both return 401 (never 500), push-token register+delete lifecycle, and /api/scenarios native-bearer returns non-empty list. Zero backend code changed this phase (only .env ADMIN_PASSWORD_ENFORCE_SYNC=true + static assets + frontend IAP client) — nothing regressed.

minor.issue: Structured error is functional but the detail string is a raw Python tuple repr: "('invalid_grant: Invalid grant: account not found', {'error': 'invalid_grant', 'error_description': 'Invalid grant: account not found'})". This is due to _verify_google_receipt propagating the exception args tuple as-is into parsed['error']. Contract-wise it is still a 400 (not 422/500) and mobile clients can key on 'invalid_grant' substring, but a clean detail string (str(exc) or exc.args[0]) would be tidier.

2_web_login_cookie.admin_password_enforce_sync_effect: admin login still succeeds after restart with .env-sourced password — sync did not break auth

5_iap_apple_verify_contract.interpretation: Pydantic accepted the contract shape; endpoint reached Apple provider-auth stage and failed there — exactly as expected without a real StoreKit receipt.

6_iap_google_verify_contract.interpretation: Pydantic accepted the contract shape; endpoint reached Google service-account auth and failed with invalid_grant — expected without a live Google service account matched to purchase_token.

action_items: OPTIONAL/COSMETIC: In routes/iap.py _verify_google_receipt error propagation (~L2240), coerce the propagated exception into a clean string (str(exc) or exc.args[0]) instead of letting the tuple-repr flow into HTTPException detail. Not blocking — mobile client can still key on 'invalid_grant' substring.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/iap.py:1725-1748 get_iap_products — correctly resolves current user with a soft get_current_user (works anon), returns product list with jurisdictional fee estimates. Matches the 4 expected product IDs.

routes/iap.py:2099-2131 get_iap_status — proper 401 gate, projects _id off Mongo doc, includes latest_transaction from iap_transactions collection, returns full plan/status/platform/product_id/expires_at/auto_renewing contract expected by the native expo-iap client.

routes/iap.py:2198-2230 verify_apple_receipt — Pydantic body (transaction_id required, receipt_data optional) matches native client payload shape; provider auth failure surfaces as structured 400 'Apple API authentication failed' (never 500) — good contract behavior.

routes/iap.py:2233-2264 verify_google_receipt — Pydantic body (purchase_token, product_id required) matches native client; provider auth failure surfaces as 400 with invalid_grant description. Minor: detail string is a tuple repr — see minor issue.

Phase 2B endpoints (native SSO, push-token, scenarios) confirmed unchanged and unaffected by the .env-only Phase 3 change. Middleware AUTH_TOKEN_REDACT_PATHS still in effect for /api/auth/google/native and /api/auth/apple/native — no request-body dumps observed.
test_credentials: admin@realaicoach.app (password from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — password NOT printed. Verified working in both web-cookie and native-Bearer modes after ADMIN_PASSWORD_ENFORCE_SYNC=true restart.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Only a transient push_token document upserted then deleted for admin user during test_push_token_register_then_delete. No IAP transactions created (both verify endpoints failed at provider-auth stage, before _apply_iap_subscription).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 (frontend-only expo-iap native client + universal-links static assets + ADMIN_PASSWORD_ENFORCE_SYNC=true) has zero backend code changes and this regression proves nothing broke. IAP endpoint contracts verified with bogus payloads: /apple/verify → 400 'Apple API authentication failed'; /google/verify → 400 with 'invalid_grant' in detail. IAP products endpoint is PUBLIC (get_current_user is soft, returns 200 even without auth) and returns exactly the 4 expected product IDs. Native expo-iap client can safely rely on this contract. Admin user is currently plan=premium/status=active (from earlier iterations). Google detail string is a raw tuple repr — cosmetic only, mobile client can still substring-match 'invalid_grant'. For future success-path testing, real Apple StoreKit receipts and real Google Play purchase_tokens are required (impossible in preview).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. Only one cosmetic observation: routes/iap.py _verify_google_receipt propagates the caught exception's .args tuple into parsed['error'], so the HTTPException detail becomes a Python tuple repr string. Reproduction: POST /api/iap/google/verify with any bogus purchase_token → detail = "('invalid_grant: ...', {...})". Mitigation (optional): in _verify_google_receipt catch block, set error = str(exc) or exc.args[0] before returning.
